title: Added the Heart Rate Zones calculator
description: I added a calculator for estimating heart-rate training zones.

title: Added the Supplement Tracker
description: I added a separate place to log daily supplements and approved medications, set dose targets, and review past days.

title: Added Diet Arena
description: I added side-by-side diet comparisons, including eating patterns, typical foods, and evidence summaries.

title: Added export options for bowls and grocery plans
description: I added options to export saved Bowl Builder bowls and grocery plans.

title: Added Grocery Budget Calculator
description: I added a grocery budgeting tool to plan costs by item, price, and servings, and save named plans.

title: Expanded the peptide guides
description: I added 18 peptide information pages to the research library.

title: Added supplement and peptide guides
description: I published new supplement and peptide guides with research and safety information.

title: Added Bowl Builder
description: I added a meal builder that totals calories and macros as you change foods and portions.

title: Added 11 diet guides
description: I added guides to 11 eating patterns, including DASH, keto, Mediterranean, and Whole30.

title: Added Waist-to-Height Ratio calculator
description: I added a calculator that estimates waist-to-height ratio from your measurements.

title: Added fitness and nutrition calculators
description: I added calculators for calorie needs, TDEE, BMR, macros, body measurements, and exercise estimates.

title: Added Scorekeeper
description: I added a scoreboard for tracking players and updating scores during games.

title: Added energy and currency preferences
description: You can now choose kcal or kJ and the currency symbol shown for costs.

title: Nawtch launched (formerly Foop).
description: I launched Nawtch to the public as the new name for my personal project, Foop.

title: Added weight tracking
description: I added daily weight logging and charts, along with half-serving food logs and more detailed graphs.

title: Added barcode scanning
description: I added barcode scanning to look up product details and prefill the food form.
